name: Cinnamon Salt Dough Gingerbread Decorations
subtitle: Handmade ornaments for seasonal display
description: Bake cinnamon-scented salt-dough shapes until fully hard, then paint and finish them with ribbon for hanging. These decorations are for display only and are not edible.

ingredients.item: plain flour plus extra for dusting
brown poster paint and white puffy paint

instructions.text: Preheat the oven according to the available recipe temperature; no temperature was supplied in the facts.
Mix the flour, cinnamon, and salt. Add enough water to form a workable dough, then knead until smooth.
Dust the work surface with flour and roll the dough to a thick, even sheet.
Cut 16 gingerbread shapes and make a small hole in each for hanging ribbon.
Arrange the shapes on a baking sheet and bake for 180 minutes. Continue drying for up to 120 minutes, if needed, until completely hard and set.
Cool the decorations fully. They are non-edible craft items; no food-safe internal temperature endpoint applies.
Paint the cooled shapes with the brown poster paint and white puffy paint using paintbrushes, then let the paint dry completely.
Thread ribbon through the holes for hanging.
